reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the finding correctly proposes no redline and no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant classification.

The cited text supports the rationale: § 13.1/13.2 (p0197-p0198) vest outright ownership of all IP in hardware, software, design and documentation of Products in IBM (our side) with assignment from MSL, which meets or exceeds the LICENSE preferred position (no revocability, free to extend use to Related Companies/contractors, transferable to successors).

The restrictive grant language in p0208 and p1136 runs from us to the vendor (limiting MSL's rights in IBM IP), so it benefits our party and is correctly not flagged under the 'do not flag a clause that benefits our party' instruction.

The failed deterministic check on 'affiliates covered by the licence' is a phrasing/heuristic artefact: where we own the IP outright there is no inbound grant clause in which affiliates would be named, so the miss does not indicate a substantive gap.

The residual point (p1136: MSL conveys no licence in MSL or third-party software to IBM) is mutual, sits outside the Product IP we own, and retains a separate-written-agreement consent path, so it is short of walk-away and is appropriately noted in the rationale rather than raised as a deviation.
